what_this_sweep_established: What a solve reads of a written matrix is what the engine reads. At both matrices written, the engine's own output at the matrix's merge gives the tube loss the solve gave to all sixteen digits (0.7727011965876796 at layer 0's attention, 0.9109786639356681 at its feed-forward) and the furthest parts to four digits (0.8949 and 0.2387 against 0.8949 and 0.2386; 0.9881 and 0.9483 against 0.9882 and 0.9483). The misreading that ended controlled-bf16-1 is gone, on a second and a third case.

The first matrix trains. Layer 0's attention, changed by 0.29% of the matrix with every bound of its own merge held on every third of the fitting answers and on all together, leaves the fitting answers 0.7727 of their tube loss there (15 stages of the ridge path, to 2^-9 of the unit). In controlled-bf16-1 the same matrix was changed by 3.6e-6 and left 0.99976: there one direction cell at the answers' first place, read in the wrong form, stopped the pull.

A merge left outside is brought back in the file's BF16 at a matrix 6144 wide. Layer 0's attention left the feed-forward's merge 35.2 past its bounds in all (furthest part 4.89 times its bound); the feed-forward's own solve brought every bound of every third and of all together back inside, in 22 rounds, with the matrix changed by 2.13%. Read there, the fitting answers are left 0.911 of their tube loss (0.907 before the bringing back).
The recorder's early stop: a build pass at layer 0 took 5 to 16 s where controlled-bf16-1's took 117.

what_the_parts_say: Two kinds of parts fill, and they are different things. At places 148 to 151, 267, 478, 37 and 24 the group's answers moved together (0.94 to 1.00 common): that is the group's pattern moving to the side, which the bound exists to limit, with bounds at 0.005 to 0.3 of the merge's median. At the answers' first place the answers each moved their own way (0.06 to 0.09 common): the group's pattern there moved by about 0.06 of the bound (2e-10 squared), and what fills the bound is the mean of the single rows' squared movements, 3.4e-9, held to the sampling variance of the group's mean, 3.3e-9. The answers of a group differ from each other there by thirty times that (the bound is their variance over 30), so each row moved by about 0.035 of what two answers of its group differ by.

After the bringing back the feed-forward's matrix stands at its bounds by construction (the least change that holds them): the read third's furthest part is at 0.9997 (the first place, direction), and no part of any pull step, at any ridge, held every bound and left less tube loss. A matrix that had to be brought back gained nothing after it, here as at layer 1's attention on the rows kept from controlled-bf16-1 (0.9552 against 0.9592).

Layer 0's last merge reads 2 to 17% further along its bounds than the feed-forward's merge does at the same parts (place 151 direction 0.985 to 1.106, place 150 size 0.948 to 1.113, the first place 0.981 to 1.039). A feed-forward solve that holds its own merge at its bounds therefore leaves the layer's last merge outside, at every layer where its solve ends at a bound. This was declared as the open risk (repeating_pattern_check, l) and is what ended the sweep.

failures_only: The sweep ended at its third of 70 matrices, not accepted.

The bringing back at layer 0's feed-forward took 22 rounds and about 83 minutes, every round but the last at its cap of 80 passes: its steps were cut short, and the amount outside fell from 35.2 to 0.0002 over 21 rounds (5.4, 2.8, 1.7, 1.2 after the first four). The build prints nothing inside a matrix, so for 88 minutes nothing said where it stood.

A taking back reaches one matrix and only its pull. With layer 0's last merge outside after a bringing back, nothing could be taken back, though the attention's pull two positions before is what moved it.
Two predictions of layer 0's attention were wrong (above).
what_this_changes: The solver's part, which is this session's: (1) the layer's last merge has to be held by the feed-forward's solve, not found outside one position later; (2) a matrix that is brought back to its bounds has no room to pull, so the bringing back and the pull have to be one solve, or the pull has to start with room; (3) the bringing back's steps have to be aimed within their passes, or it costs an hour and a half a matrix; (4) the build has to say where it stands.

The allowance's part, which is Astra's and this session's to decide (the dispatch of November 11 on the what-worked study's decision 1): at the answers' first place the bound holds single rows' movement to the sampling variance of the group's mean. On this sweep's model the rows moved 0.035 of what two answers of the group differ by and the pattern 0.06 of its bound, and the part stands at 1.04. Holding the pattern to the variance of the mean and the rows to the variance of the answers is the study's recommended option; this is its measurement 3 taken on a real case, and it is evidence for the choice, not the choice.

Nothing here bears on whether the trace difference carries the capability: the earlier repairs and their transfer stand as they are recorded. This sweep is a finding about the configuration: what in it now works (the reading, the first matrix, the bringing back) and what in it stops a sweep at the first layer.
